threat_event: Ransomware spreads across acquired terminals and into the TOS
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 21 acquired terminals on flat networks with local accounts and no EDR
existing_controls: Site VPNs to the hub; TOS in the cloud with MFA for office users
treatment_plan: Segment terminal networks (office, OT, guest); EDR; join SYS-G1
owner: Director, Security and Compliance (Transload and Wholesale)

threat_event: Loading rack controllers are manipulated through always-on vendor remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Rack vendor has always-on remote access at 23 hazmat terminals
existing_controls: Safety interlocks on racks; operator present during loading
treatment_plan: Remove always-on access; vendor sessions through PAM; contract terms

threat_event: Fraudulent supplier bank account change diverts payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Call-back verification not enforced in the ERP for 3 of 7 accounts payable teams
treatment_plan: Enforced call-back step in the ERP workflow; bank account validation

threat_event: Impersonated customer places fraudulent orders for pickup
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal accounts with password only for 18% of customers
existing_controls: Credit checks; pickup verification at gates

threat_event: TOS outage stops terminal throughput for a day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single TOS instance in provider A
existing_controls: Paper bills of lading; scale tickets

threat_event: Federal Contract Information is exposed or the FAR safeguards are not met
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: FCI kept in a restricted workspace; 2 FAR safeguards partly met (P03)
existing_controls: Restricted workspace for 23 users; SSO with MFA
treatment_plan: Close the P03 FAR rows (media sanitization record; visitor logs at the contracts office)

threat_event: Covered telecommunications equipment is in use in terminal CCTV and not reported
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No inventory of CCTV recorder makes at acquired terminals
treatment_plan: Inventory CCTV and network equipment at all terminals; report any covered equipment within 1 business day as the clause requires

threat_event: Corrupted TOS data produces wrong hazmat shipping papers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shipping papers printed from TOS data
existing_controls: Loader checks placards and papers against the load
owner: Hazmat compliance manager, Transload and Wholesale

threat_event: Telematics vendor breach exposes driver personal information
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Driver data held by the vendor
treatment_plan: Breach notice terms in the contract; data minimization

threat_event: Compromise at a terminal goes undetected without EDR or logging
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No EDR at 21 terminals; no logs from terminal firewalls
treatment_plan: EDR and firewall log forwarding at all terminals
owner: Director, Security and Compliance (Transload and Wholesale)

threat_event: Terminal OT devices are unknown and unpatched
existing_controls: Site lists kept by terminal managers

threat_event: Division hazmat security plan does not address cyber threats to shipping data and rack controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Plan written for physical security only
affected_asset_or_process: Transload and Wholesale hazmat security plan
treatment_plan: Add cyber measures to the plan (P03)
owner: Hazmat compliance manager, Transload and Wholesale

threat_event: Stolen EDI partner credentials on the integration platform are used to alter orders
Pricing model produces unreviewed or erroneous prices
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model live since 2025 without council review

threat_event: Terminal security practices differ by site without a division standard
treatment_plan: Division supplement with terminal OT standard (P06)
owner: Director, Security and Compliance (Transload and Wholesale)

threat_event: Scale tickets are altered for theft
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Scale software at some terminals allows edits
